source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != background and all(v == row[0] for v in row)}
    cols = {c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != background and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r in rows or c in cols:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
